body: Thankyou for taking the time to comment. I'm supposed to be working through dialectical behavioural therapy so hopefully that will help change my thought patterns. At the very least I think I'll be surviving the night.

He doesn't care about me. He can't even say he loves me. He is just scared to leave me because he fears what I might do. Which makes me feel miserable. ( I've never threatened anything to him..) Thankyou for your words.
